item.title: Festive frontrunners: Winners announced for Geraldton’s first Christmas storefront competition
item.description: Geraldton’s inaugural storefront decoration competition has awarded its first winners, with the whole community benefiting from the festive spirit brought to the CBD.

item.title: Northampton’s Patrick Cripps teams up with Tourism WA to showcase West is best ahead of State of Origin clash
item.description: Northampton’s Patrick Cripps has joined forces with Tourism WA to entice more Victorians to head west ahead of next month’s State of Origin.

item.title: What I See with Peter Fiorenza: It’s a sad indictment that technology has made life so impersonal
item.description: Why has life become so impersonal? Communication today is mainly always through the use of messaging via our mobile phones or email.

item.title: Derek Goforth: Final leg of US adventure taking in Florida Keys, Miami and Everglades a stunning experience
item.description: Derek Goforth details the change of pace in the third and final leg of his family’s American adventure — taking in the Florida Keys, Miami and Everglades.

item.title: Discarded trolleys, scooters recovered from Geraldton jetty’s watery depths by youths
item.description: A group of young people have leapt into action, transforming themselves into a jetty junk retrieval gang to keep the waterways clean.

item.title: Festival headliners and indie rockers Old Mervs playing in Geraldton at The Wintersun on Friday night
item.description: Geraldton music fans will have a chance to see a regional WA band play in town before they jet to the Governors Ball in New York later in the year.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association round 12: Martians and Rams on double duty as competition hits home stretch
item.description: With ladders tightening and legs starting to feel the season, round 12 has all the ingredients for a weekend of softball where effort, depth and a bit of grit will go a long way.

item.title: Geraldton Water Polo Association round 12: B52’s dive into second half of season after extended break
item.description: Round 12 shapes as another important checkpoint, with ladders starting to take real definition and plenty of sides keen to make a statement as the back half of the season approaches.

item.title: Geraldton Magistrates Court: Two men jailed over similar, but separate, high-speed police pursuits
item.description: A 36-year-old man with an “unrelenting record” including nine convictions for driving without a licence was handed a jail term of more than a year last week over a dangerous high-speed pursuit in Spalding.

item.title: Country week cricket championships: Geraldton stumbles at the starting blocks as title defence gets under way
item.description: Geraldton’s start to its country week A-section title defence didn’t go to plan, as Eastern Goldfields knocked over the reigning champions by five wickets on Sunday.
